question: 18 LPA startup offer vachindi (runway 2 years), ippudu 12 LPA MNC lo 1 year exp. Savings 1 lakh matrame. Switch avvala?

box_1_flrrc.fact: Startup 18 LPA vs MNC 12 LPA (6 LPA difference), startup runway 2 years, savings 1 lakh only, exp 1 year
box_1_flrrc.logic: Salary jump 50% + learning ekkuva, kani runway 2 years ante job risk, savings takkuva ante buffer ledu
box_1_flrrc.reasoning: Early career lo growth + learning value ekkuva. Risk ni buffer tho cover cheyochu, kani ippudu buffer ledu
box_1_flrrc.representation: Decision matrix: Salary growth vs Learning vs Job risk
box_1_flrrc.conclusion: Go, kani 3 months expenses buffer ready chesukoni join avvu

box_2_equation.regret_probability: NoGo regret 55% (6 LPA/year growth miss), Go regret 35% (runway aipothe job search)

box_3_graph: Bar chart: Go 3.9 vs NoGo 2.9. Savings buffer lekapothe Go risk penchutundi

box_4_risk.worst: Startup 8 months lo shutdown + savings 1 lakh tho job search
box_4_risk.middle: Startup ki joining 2 months delay adigi, MNC lo untu savings 2 lakh cheyyi, tarvata switch

box_5_next_action: This week: startup funding status + salary on-time record adugu, 3 months expenses (approx) buffer plan chey, tarvata offer accept cheyyi

question: 5 lakh savings undi, emergency fund ledu, monthly expense 25k. Anni SIP lo pettala leka 2 lakh emergency ga pettala?
